name: Xingxiulong
sum: Xingxiulong is a bipedal basal sauropodiform from the Early Jurassic Lufeng Formation of Yunnan, China, with two species.
wsnote: Adults of X. chengi, 1-1.5 m tall at the hip (Wikipedia revision); X. yueorum was larger.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted. X. chengi is based on three specimens from Sankeshu Village, Lufeng County; X. yueorum has the holotype LF2015-NO01 (Zhangjiaao Member).
material: Three specimens of X. chengi (two adults and an immature individual) that together form a mostly complete skeleton; a partial articulated skeleton of X. yueorum.
biology: The authors of the Wikipedia revision note that, unlike sauropods, it may still have been bipedal.
author: Wang et al. 2017

images.artist: Ya-Ming Wang, Hai-Lu You & Tao Wang
images.caption: Skeletal diagram of Xingxiulong showing the preserved bones.
